title: Uniqueness of prescribed-node radial bound states for a zero-mass double-power equation
summary: We study radial bound states of \[ Δu-\abs{u}^{q-1}u+\abs{u}^{p-1}u=0 \quad\text{in }\R^n, \qquad n\ge3,\qquad 1 0$. Its absolute maximum is attained at the origin. This confirms the zero-mass, Sobolev-subcritical case of Tang's double-power uniqueness conjecture. The proof adapts Tang's phase-transition analysis and combines it with a finite-level separation argument inspired by Cortázar--García-Huidobro--Yarur.
